FOR FEAT-002 (exact contract): request header `x-relay-token` (case-insensitive, trimmed on both sides, constant-time compare); routes `GET /feed/<id>` (query string ignored) and `GET /page/<id>?u=<encodeURIComponent(url)>` where `new URL(u).href` must start with allowlist.pages[id] (https only, no credentials); non-GET including HEAD -> 404. Response headers: `x-relay-cache` = `hit|miss|bypass|stale`; `x-relay-stale` = stored fetchedAt ISO string, present only with `stale`; `cache-control: no-store` on every response; 200s carry only the upstream `content-type` (fallback `application/octet-stream`), no content-encoding/length/cf-* headers. Error bodies are `application/json`: 401 `{"error":"unauthorized"}`, 404 `{"error":"not found"}`, 502 `{"error":"upstream failed","url":<upstream url>,"upstreamStatus":<int|null>,"cfMitigated":<string|null>,"reason":"status"|"timeout"|"network"}` (a 200 with cf-mitigated is reported as upstreamStatus 200, reason status). Upstream headers are exactly user-agent, accept-language, accept (feed or html). Worker exports: createRelay({ fetchImpl, now, sleep, log }), tokenOk, resolveRoute, FRESH_MS 7200000, MAX_STORE_BYTES 4000000, UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT_MS 10000, RETRY_429_MS 2000, STORE_TTL_S 2592000, CRON_GAP_MS 2000, default createRelay(). Log lines: `{event:'upstream', path:'request'|'cron', url, status, cfRay, cfCacheStatus, cfMitigated, bytes, ms, attempt[, reason]}` (reason only when fetch threw) and one `{event:'cron', refreshed:[ids], failed:[ids], bypassed:[ids], ms}` per tick. Item 14's dry run: `$env:RELAY_URL='https://ahead-relay.rishtapatra.workers.dev'; $env:RELAY_TOKEN=(Get-Content -Raw "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\ahead\relay-token.txt").Trim()`; all six copies are warm now, so expect `via relay` with `hit`. relay/README.md points to a root README section titled exactly `Relay for Cloudflare-blocked feeds` (item 13 must use that heading). DEVIATIONS FROM THE PLAN (all small, with reasons): (1) schema.js `isRelayPagePrefix` also requires the prefix to be already normalized (`new URL(v).href === v`), because the Worker tests `new URL(u).href.startsWith(prefix)`; an un-normalized prefix (uppercase host, missing path slash) would silently 404 every page fetch, so the config fails loudly instead. (2) build-allowlist.mjs does `mkdirSync(relay/src/, { recursive: true })` before writing so the generator works on a fresh checkout (the first run here failed without it). (3) KV namespace title is `RELAY_CACHE` (see DEPLOY). (4) The cron summary field for over-cap bodies is named `bypassed` (plan left it unnamed). (5) Root README 'Adding a source' line describes viaRelay (rss/atom/sitemap, no template, run `node relay/build-allowlist.mjs`) and relayPagePrefix in one sentence. (6) Extra unit cases beyond the plan's list: token trimming, `/feed/constructor` (prototype key) 404, HEAD 404, 304 -> stale, 429-then-200 -> miss, exact FRESH_MS boundary, content-type cut to 100 chars + octet-stream fallback, default export smoke test. OPS NOTES: Invoke-WebRequest progress bars flood stdout when captured; set `$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'` in scripts (the first matrix run's output was unreadable for that reason and was rerun). Substack feeds come back from Substack's cache (cf-cache-status HIT) in ~200-450 ms; origin-bound (BYPASS) requests are where the 429s happen.
